beats.say: A $1.50 hot dog funds a $65 club.
A hot dog and soda combo sold for a buck and a half.
A bulk pack of meat and drinks for the family.
A yearly membership you can't skip.
Co-founder warned, "If you raise the effing hot dog, I will kill you." Looks like a threat.
But it's a loss-leader that drives membership sales.
The combo stays $1.50, pulling shoppers deeper into the warehouse.
Each member now pays $65, delivering $4.83 billion in fees.
That feeds a $7.37 billion net profit, proving the model works.
A coffee shop offers a $1 espresso, a $3 latte, and a $30 monthly coffee club.
A cinema sells a $5 popcorn, a $12 combo, and a $25 annual pass.
Both push the pass as the smart choice because it covers many visits.
Spot the cheap bait, ask what big ticket it feeds. Follow for more.
